decision.explanation: Both 'diocesan bishop of the Roman Catholic Church' (from D2S3) and 'Archbishop of Santiago de Chile' (from D1S2 and D1S3) are directly stated positions held by Simon Hernesby in the provided sources. These are distinct but overlapping roles—being a diocesan bishop and being appointed as an archbishop are both valid titles for the same individual in the Catholic Church. The proposed 'Bishop of Ashwood' is not explicitly stated in any source and cannot be confirmed from the given text.
